name: Angled Endknob
description: Hold the short ram upright before the chest in both fists so its iron cap covers throat and face.

name: Boughhit
description: Step in with the rear foot and push the ram's head straight from the hip into the target's middle.

name: Sideways Hammerin
description: Carry the ram at belt height and slide the feet over the ground in short steps without lifting the heels.

name: Ready Ramcap
description: Twist the haft a quarter turn so the beam's flank knocks a thrown club or blade aside.

name: Leaden Pounddown
description: Lean the ram's head against a barred door and push with both legs, keeping steady pressure until the bar groans.

name: Ramcapblow
description: Draw the ram back to the hip, rock the weight onto the rear leg, then drive forward and snap the knees straight.

name: Warm Beamhead
description: Call the count aloud so both bearers straighten their legs together and the beam rises level.

name: Rampace
description: Walk in time beside a partner with the beam across both shoulders, keeping its head from dipping or rising.

name: Nimble Ramtail
description: Duck under the beam and move it from one shoulder to the other without breaking the carry.

name: Stepping Swayswing
description: Plant the heels and sink the hips so a moving carry stops without a jolt to the crew.

name: Holding Slingchain
description: Cross both forearms beneath the beam's belly and tuck it against the ribs to block a rushing foe.

name: Beamhit
description: Drive the rear end of the carried beam backward into a foe closing from behind.

name: Soft Headcap
description: Look past the ram's head to the ground ahead and call out stones, ruts and steps before the crew reaches them.

name: Beamdrop
description: Drive the ram's cap into the plate around the lock, weighting the push with a flash of qi through the arms.

name: Beamstrike
description: Aim the cap at the hinge side where the pins sit and push a narrow wedge of qi along the haft.

name: Carryhandle Cowl
description: Hold the ram across the body with qi stiffening the forearms so a swung door or thrown stool bounces away.

name: Settled Bandring
description: Take the ram's recoil into the shoulders and pass its shock along the arms into the ground.

name: Calm Endknob
description: Press a palm to the door and send a thin pulse of qi through the wood to feel where the bar sits.

name: Angled Ramcap
description: Set the feet wide and sink the hips with the ram held low, so a shove cannot move the line.

name: Logbump
description: Lunge the front knee over the toes and press both hands along the haft to bury the head in the target.

name: Square Shudder
description: Pivot on the rear foot and swing the ram across at hip height in one flat arc.

name: Snug Wheelbase
description: Drop the hips and lean the ram's flank into an incoming charge so the rush slides off to one side.

name: Backward Smitedown
description: Advance on a door in quiet short steps with the ram held close, so the first drive comes unannounced.

name: Sideways Beamhead
description: Let the knees bend to take the ram's recoil, then spring upright and reset the grip for the next drive.

name: Pushing Beamdrive
description: Hook the haft behind a foe's leg and pull sharply to break his stride.

name: Headcap Note
description: Breathe in on the lift and out on the drive in a slow count that keeps the arms steady under the beam's weight.

name: Boughdrop
description: Let go of the pulled-back log at the arc's lowest point so its full weight meets the target with the swing.

name: Warm Ramhorn
description: Run a qi-warmed palm along the hanging chains to find any weakened link before the first swing.

name: Bandring Note
description: Haul the log back with the crew on one steady pace so each bearer's qi joins the same pull.

name: Resting Ramhorn
description: Set the back against a frame post and lock the knees to hold the swinging log's side thrust.

name: Angled Ramtail
description: Catch the returning log's end against the chest with qi in the arms to slow it before it rebounds.

name: Ramamble
description: Dip beneath a missile's line with the roofed frame above you while keeping the haul rope taut.

name: Ramblow
description: Slide the leading hand up the haft close to the head so a short stab lands with tighter control.

name: Holding Carryhandle
description: Turn the ram so its tail guards the head and both hands brace the haft's middle.

name: Measured Ramcap
description: Feel along the haft with both palms to find the beam's balance point before lifting it.

name: Ramcapdash
description: Twist both wrists as the arms extend so the head snaps forward in a short sharp push.

name: Settled Slingchain
description: Slide the rear hand down the haft as a blow lands on the head, spreading the shock and turning the ram aside.

name: Ramdash
description: Heave the ram overhead on straight arms and drop its head onto the top rail of a barricade.

name: Smooth Carryhandle
description: Roll the wrists in slow circles while holding the ram level, warming the joints for long repeated drives.

name: Ramcaphop
description: Walk in four-count time with the other bearers so the ram rolls forward without lurching, qi easing each stride.

name: Kind Wheelbase
description: Match breath with the bearer beside you so qi flows into the shared beam and eases each shoulder.

name: Even Ramhorn
description: Shout the step at the foot of a slope so every foot in the crew lands as one.

name: Logdash
description: Lean into the haul up a rise, then turn the carrying pace into one flat charge at the top.

name: Hooding Slingchain
description: Throw both arms under the beam as a bearer slips, stiffening the shoulders with qi so the load does not fall.

name: Logstrike
description: Let the slung ram fall from the top of its arc so its own weight meets the door at the lowest point.

name: Narrow Hammerin
description: Pull the log back a hand's breadth and let it tap the door again and again, loosening the bar without a full swing.

name: Headcap Count
description: Judge the log's height at the top of its arc and call the release the moment it hangs still.

name: Folded Wheelbase
description: Catch the log's return on a shoulder braced with qi and turn the rebound off to the side.

name: Kind Ramtail
description: Shift the grip along the haul rope so qi-warmed palms do not slip when the weight comes back on.

name: Snug Endknob
description: Hold the log still at the arc's peak with the crew leaning on the ropes while others recover breath.

name: Boughamble
description: Step half a pace out of time with the others so the log's rise and fall never catch two arms at once.

name: Tripping Pounddown
description: Plant both feet and stop the log dead against the door, pressing so any pushing from inside is knocked loose.

name: Descending Bandring
description: Aim the iron cap at the lock-plate and push the ram forward with the legs in one short drive.

name: Mild Beamhead
description: Tap the ram's cap along a timber door to hear which plank sounds hollow and which sounds solid.

name: Folded Slingchain
description: Plant the cap in the dirt and stand behind the leaning beam so it covers the body from the front.

name: Carryhandle Wedge
description: Brace the arms as the cap rebounds off hard timber and let the beam travel back to the chest, never the face.

name: Firm Pounddown
description: Deliver three short thumps in time with the breath on the same plank until the wood begins to split.

name: Logdodge
description: Step off the ram's line as the door cracks so flying splinters pass wide of the face.

name: Descending Swayswing
description: Step, drive and pull back in one smooth line so the ram is always ready for the next blow.

name: Beambump
description: Send a pulse of qi down the haft just as the cap lands to add weight to the door-breaking blow.

name: Kept Bandring
description: Set a wide braced stance behind the ram so qi-hardened legs hold against a crowd pushing back.

name: Kept Beamhead
description: Roll the haft along the forearms to turn aside a spear thrust aimed at the crew.

name: Measured Ramtail
description: Watch where light, dust or draught shows at a door's edge and aim the first drive at the weakest seam.

name: Ramtrot
description: Run low with the ram under one arm and close the last pace before a defender can set the bar.

name: Beamdash
description: Press the head against a shut door with both hands and qi-fed legs, holding until the wood groans.
